title: Semi Submarine Tour - Sharm El Sheikh
overview: Explore the Red Sea without getting wet! Enjoy stunning views of marine life, corals, and fish from the comfort of an air-conditioned armchair inside a semi-submarine. A perfect excursion for all ages!

stops.name: Underwater Viewing Stop
stops.description: Spend 60 minutes, 3 meters below the surface, observing coral reefs, exotic fish, and marine life through 18 panoramic windows.

stops.name: Upper Deck Scenic Stop
stops.description: Spend 30 minutes enjoying breathtaking views of Sharm El Maya Bay and the surrounding mountains.

includes: All transfers by an air-conditioned van
excludes: Photos taken by the camera operator (optional)
extra_tips: This is a family-friendly excursion suitable for all ages!
recommendations: Bring your ticket or booking confirmation
Sunglasses & hat for the upper deck
